newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area on Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light buyer inquiry. Sales reported on 500 heifers; 1,100 head confirmed for week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 68.00 North Plains.
Confirmed - 500 Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 1,100 Week Ago - 1,400 Year Ago - 4,600
